name: herdr-sweep
description: Digest herdr agent sessions and dispatch follow-ups only after approval, one agent at a time

label_pattern.title: Tab label pattern
label_pattern.description: Regular expression whose first capture group is the work-item ID. Example: ^([A-Z]+-\d+). Leave empty to show raw tab labels.

dispatch_commands.title: External dispatch commands
dispatch_commands.description: One entry per follow-up kind, as kind=command template. Example: rebase=my-pr-tool dispatch --rebase --pr {pr} --go. A kind with no entry uses herdr agent prompt.

states.title: States to sweep
states.description: Herdr agent lifecycle states to include. The default is done and blocked.

include_unread_idle.title: Include unread idle
include_unread_idle.description: Also include idle sessions whose last turn has not been read yet.

machines.title: Machine profiles
machines.description: Herdr --machine profiles to sweep. Leave empty to sweep the local session only. Each profile is swept and dispatched on its own.
